props.title: Small Engine Repair
props.text: A weekly show about fixing things that most people throw away: lawnmowers, toasters, friendships. Two neighbors, one garage, no sponsors.

items.title: 48. The toaster that outlived three marriages
items.text: A listener sends us a 1961 chrome toaster. We learn what a bimetal strip is, and why nothing is built like this anymore.

items.title: 47. Carburetors, explained badly
items.text: Dale finally takes apart the push mower. Rosa reads the manual out loud. Neither helps.

items.title: 46. Mailbag: your worst repair
items.text: Your stories about fixes that went wrong, including one involving a garage door and a canoe.

items.title: 45. Why does everything have a screen now
items.text: A refrigerator with Wi-Fi visits the garage. We have questions.

items.name: Rosa Delgado
items.role: Retired shop teacher. Owns more clamps than chairs.

items.name: Dale Pruitt
items.role: Lives next door. Brings the coffee and the problems.

props.title: Mailbag
props.text: Send us a question for the show.
